Gitā — Third-Party Open-Source Notices
======================================

1. Sparkle 2
   URL: https://sparkle-project.org
   License: MIT License and external licenses (full text in Sparkle-LICENSE.txt)
   Used for signed, Ed25519-verified in-app updates via https://getgita.app/appcast.xml.

2. xterm.js and @xterm/addon-fit
   URL: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
   License: MIT License (full text in xterm-LICENSE.txt and Resources/Terminal/xterm/)
   Powers the built-in repository terminal.

3. Bundled Code Fonts
   Licenses: SIL Open Font License 1.1 and MIT License (full license text alongside
   each font family in Resources/Fonts/)
   Includes Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, Cascadia Code, DM Mono, Fira Code, Fira Mono,
   Geist Mono, Hack, IBM Plex Mono, Inconsolata, Intel One Mono, JetBrains Mono,
   Martian Mono, Noto Sans Mono, Red Hat Mono, Roboto Mono, Source Code Pro, and
   Victor Mono.

4. LobeHub Icons and GitHub Octicons
   URL: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
   URL: https://github.com/primer/octicons
   License: MIT License (full text in Resources/AgentMarks/LICENSE)
   Used for AI agent and GitHub marks.

5. Simple Icons
   URL: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons
   License: CC0 1.0 Universal (full text in Resources/ProviderMarks/LICENSE.md)
   Used for GitLab and Bitbucket remote provider marks.

6. Bundled Review Skills
   Licenses: MIT License and Apache License 2.0 (full license and notice texts
   alongside each skill in Resources/ReviewSkills/)
   Includes Matt Pocock Review (MIT), Thermo-Nuclear Review (MIT), and
   Caveman Review (Apache 2.0).
